subject: wide-wheel owl automaton
requested_medium: mosaic ceramic, leather, and walnut collectible
art_direction: 猫头鹰木偶以小瓷片构成圆脸，身体两侧是软皮翼，底部单宽轮，正面神态严肃。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Design a small owl automaton standing on one broad walnut roller. Its round face consists of a few irregular celadon ceramic tiles around a short brass beak, while folded leather wings hug the sides of a wooden body. Keep the eyes small within the facial discs to avoid a giant-eye mascot. Lean it slightly forward with focused attention. Use muted blue surroundings and soft grazing light to distinguish glazed tile, worn leather, and wood grain. No clock numerals, steampunk clutter, hats, or workshop tools appear. Square 1024x1024. Keep the complete central silhouette within a circular crop, occupying about 70% of the canvas. Original design; no lettering, logos, or watermark.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected for distinct original concept, appealing silhouette and expression, requested medium, coherent shape/anatomy, clean visual hierarchy, no text or watermark
